description: The figure is a two-level donut (nested pie) chart showing the distribution of three response categories—Deceived, Partially, and Not Deceived—for two conditions labeled “Ambiguity 1 (Outer)” and “Ambiguity 2 (Inner),” with 3 slices in each ring (6 slices total across both rings). In the outer ring (Ambiguity 1), the Deceived slice is dark red at approximately 67.6%, the Partially slice is yellow at approximately 23.5%, and the Not Deceived slice is dark green at approximately 8.8%. In the inner ring (Ambiguity 2), the Deceived slice is bright red at approximately 57.9%, the Partially slice is yellow (its percentage label is present but visually obscured/blurred), and the Not Deceived slice is light green at approximately 10.5%. Two legends appear on the right, one for each ring, mapping colors to labels; percentage values are printed directly on the rings, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized beyond the concentric layout.
